question: Shantanu starts from Point A and drives 4 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 5 km, then turns right and drives 7 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 10 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km, and then stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified).
solution:
**Given:**

Shantanu starts from Point A and drives 4 km towards the north.

He then takes a right turn and drives 5 km.

He then turns right and drives 7 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 10 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km, and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/836a377d3e64c375570a8a3ca5136d553992a97899a8dfd3b79f0d9ac774346f.png] 

**Hence, the correct answer is option 3**
